description: For finite \(\Delta\subseteq\operatorname{Diag}^{+}(A)\) with \(A\ne\varnothing\), its fixed pattern is a quantifier-free conjunction of atoms, true at the source tuple. Its existential closure is existential-positive and, in every nonempty target, holds exactly when some interpretation of the added names satisfies \(\Delta\). The formula is fixed before the target is chosen.
